title: 第九章洪荒行

content_zh:
在洪荒中很多大神通都通过论道提升修为，修炼靠闭门造车是不可能不断突破的，迟早会遇到瓶颈。到时只有靠感悟天地或者与人论道借鉴他人的道才能继续突破，所以说洪荒中大神通者遇到，只要不是有仇怨等一些其他情况，一般都会论道一番。而在洪荒中论道一般分两种方法，金仙之下的修士只能通过讲出自己对大道的领悟来论道，而修为达到金仙境界以上的修士，就可以直接通过庆云和顶上三花来论道。庆云和三花都是修士境界达到金仙以后才能凝练出来，蕴含修士对道的领悟，修士可已通过三花和庆云将自己的道展现出来。所以金仙以上的大神通者都是直接通过庆云三花来论道的，那时只要相互通过庆云将大道感悟演绎成种种异象。因此，玄元也是希望有强大的存在来与自己论道一番，说不定能够直接突破修为，不过现在是没有可能了。
出关之后，玄元又来看了一下青竹，作为天地间的生灵，以如今的条件，除了先天开启灵智而化出人形，更有的可以带领一族崛起，再就是如青竹这样的存在，后天开灵，要想化形而出，还不知要有多长的路要走呢。又为他讲了一次道，玄元一动便已是离开了蓬莱，第一次出行了。
看着这无边海域，玄元心情激荡，恨不得仰天长啸，此去洪荒，可是强者众多，凶险无比，也是机缘无数，第一次接触这样的世界，玄元如何能不激动，心之向往，必有所行，玄元踏浪而行，穿梭与海浪之中，向着洪荒大地行去。到了地仙，便有了简单的飞行之能，天仙便可翱翔于九天之上，玄元曾经也是为了追求速度，创造出飞行的法门，名为踏天行，念头一动，便可行至数万里开外，速度自然不用多说，但是好歹也是第一次出来，倒也不必着急怎么也得好好欣赏一下这个世界才行，虽然四周都是海水，但也挡不住玄元的兴致，多少年了，终于看到这个世界了，玄心中感慨万分。
这海上一行就是上百年，期间玄元也看到了海中的生灵，已有灵智，甚至化出了人形，但是玄元并不打算与之接触，只是新奇地看着这一切，也在一些海岛上发现一些太初奇珍，是炼器的好材料，至于一些没长眼，惹上他的生灵，也是直接打杀了，环境变了，心态也是变了，对此玄元知道不能手软，洪荒弱肉强食，这些就当是适应洪荒世界的一次经验吧。
“终于到了，这将是新的开始，我将要在这里开创属于自己的传奇。”踏在岸上，看着眼前的大陆，无边无际，充满着厚重与庄严的气息。“这就是洪荒了，万古的洪荒，神话的起源，强者的乐园与坟墓，修行之圣地。”继续前行，此次的目的地，不周山，当然也是缓步前进。
当然玄元也是避开那些大族皇朝，他知道自己如今的实力虽然也是一方强者了，但是面对大族皇朝的无数强者还是不够看的，自己可不会傻乎乎的前去搭话，，洪荒凶兽主要分布在洪荒西部和北部，而其他势力也是大多分布在东部和南部，中部的反而比较少，这也不难理解，因为中部盘古威压太盛，不适合族群居住，所以只是分布在洪荒中部的外围。
洪荒纵横不知多少亿里，即便是大罗金仙全力飞行，从东到西，也得飞上千年才行，真正是广阔无边。一路上看着各种奇景，生灵争斗，玄元心情愉悦，“终于是有点生气的样子了，不像我那道场，冷冷清清的，还是洪荒好啊，看来我决定出来还是十分正确的。”边走边收些罕见的材料，也是一场不错的旅途了。
“呔，那小子，赶快把那宝物放下，可饶你不死。”悠闲的玄元终于是遇上了麻烦，就在他发现一座大山中正孕育着一块先天玄铁，正要收起之时，一声大喝让玄元一愣，接着哭笑不得，居然是遇上了传说中的打劫，而且还打劫到他身上来了。“诸位道友有礼了，不知叫住贫道，有何指教啊？”看着下面一群人身兽首，还没有完全化形的生物，玄元不由得来了兴趣，生活太枯燥，有点调味剂也好。

content_en:
In the ancient world, many great supernatural powers improved their cultivation through discussion. It is impossible to continuously make breakthroughs by practicing behind closed doors. Sooner or later, you will encounter a bottleneck. At that time, only by comprehending the world or discussing the Tao with others and learning from others can we continue to make breakthroughs. Therefore, when people with great supernatural powers in the ancient times encountered them, as long as there was no enmity or other circumstances, they would usually discuss the Tao. There are generally two ways to discuss Tao in ancient times. Monks below the Golden Immortal level can only discuss Tao by speaking out their own understanding of the Tao, while monks who have reached the Golden Immortal level or above can directly discuss Tao through Qingyun and Dingding Sanhua. Qingyun and Sanhua can only be condensed after the monks reach the golden immortal realm. They contain the monk's understanding of the Tao. The monks can already show their Tao through Sanhua and Qingyun. Therefore, those with great supernatural powers above the Golden Immortal level directly discussed the Tao through Qingyun Sanhua. At that time, they only needed to interpret the Taoist insights into various visions through Qingyun. Therefore, Xuanyuan also hopes that a powerful being will discuss things with him, and maybe he can directly break through his cultivation level, but it is not possible now.
After leaving seclusion, Xuanyuan took a look at Qingzhu again. As a living being in the world, with the current conditions, in addition to being born with spiritual wisdom and taking the form of a human, he could also lead a clan to rise. Then there are beings like Qingzhu who can develop spirituality the day after tomorrow. In order to take the form of a human being, there is still a long way to go. After preaching to him again, Xuanyuan left Penglai and traveled for the first time.
Looking at the boundless sea, Xuanyuan's mood was agitated, and he wished he could roar to the sky. He was going to the wild land, but there were many strong men, extremely dangerous, and countless opportunities. It was the first time he came into contact with such a world. How could Xuanyuan not be excited? His heart's longing must be fulfilled. Xuanyuan walked on the waves, shuttled among the waves, and headed towards the wild land. When you reach the Earth Immortal, you have the simple ability to fly, and the Celestial Immortal can soar above the nine heavens. Xuanyuan once also created a method of flying in pursuit of speed, called Tiantian Xing. With a thought, you can fly tens of thousands of miles away. Needless to say, the speed is , but at least it was the first time to come out, so there was no need to worry. I had to appreciate the world. Although there was sea water all around, it couldn't stop Xuan Yuan's interest. After so many years, he finally saw this world, and Xuan Yuan was filled with emotion.
This journey on the sea lasted for hundreds of years. During this period, Xuanyuan also saw the creatures in the sea. They had developed intelligence and even transformed into human forms. However, Xuanyuan did not intend to contact them. He just watched everything with curiosity. He also found some Taichu treasures on some islands. It is a good material for refining weapons. As for some creatures that have no eyesight and offend him, they are directly killed. The environment has changed, and the mentality has also changed. Xuanyuan knows that he cannot be soft on this. In the ancient times, the weak and the strong preyed on the weak. This should be regarded as an experience in adapting to the ancient world.
"We are finally here. This will be a new beginning. I will create my own legend here." Stepping on the shore, looking at the continent in front of me, it is boundless and full of gravity and solemnity. "This is the prehistoric era, the prehistoric era, the origin of myths, the paradise and tomb of the strong, the holy land of practice." Keep moving forward, this time's destination, Buzhou Mountain, of course, is also moving forward slowly.
Of course, Xuanyuan also avoided those big clan dynasties. He knew that although his current strength was also a strong one, he was still not enough to face the countless strong men of the big clan dynasties. He would not foolishly go to talk to them.
There are countless millions of miles across the ancient world. Even if Daluo Jinxian flew at full strength, it would take thousands of years to fly from east to west. It is truly boundless.. Seeing all kinds of wonders and fighting creatures along the way, Xuanyuan was in a happy mood. "Finally, I feel a little angry. It's not like my dojo, which is deserted and deserted. It's better to go back to ancient times. It seems that my decision to come out is quite right." It was a good journey to collect some rare materials while walking.
"Hey, boy, put that treasure down quickly, I'll spare your life." The leisurely Xuanyuan finally ran into trouble. Just when he found a piece of innate black iron gestating in a mountain, and when he was about to put it away, Xuanyuan was stunned by a loud shout, and then he didn't know whether to laugh or cry. He actually encountered a legendary robbery, and it even happened to him. "Fellow Taoists, please be polite. I don't know how to stop this poor Taoist. Do you have any advice?" Looking at the group of creatures with human bodies and animal heads below, which have not yet fully transformed, Xuanyuan couldn't help but become interested. Life is too boring. A little spice would be nice.
